selection_rule: Numerically smallest available BIDS subject other than sub-99 with PSG EDF and human-scored events TSV; no selection on stage counts, coordinates or differences; verify pid differs before treating it as another participant. Report failure rather than replace after outcomes.
preprocessing: same verified fullnight 30/30-second config, force fresh features, no per-stage fit
eligibility: same recorded known stage plus finite complete 3D/9D vector and true existing producer masks
descriptive_check: For every canonical 3D and 9D coordinate report N2 minus Wake medians separately in both participants; compare sign without p-values, pooled estimates, post-hoc selection or tuning. Zero is reported as zero; absent/unsupported contrast null. Report all stage medians and denominators.
support_limits: not_assessed stage purity, unknown effective filter support; no stage Q/WQ/diffusion or population qualification
